title: Promoting intellectual security in academia: the crucial role of information technology in modern education
core_idea: Examine the role of information technology in promoting intellectual security among university students in Jordan, focusing on potential differences by gender, academic specialization, and academic level using a purpose-designed questionnaire.
tldr: A study that investigates how IT supports intellectual security among 640 Jordanian university students, employing a validated 35-item survey to assess variations by gender, discipline, and academic level.
